# Generated by HelpMake. Do not edit.
# Regenerate with: hm --gen cmake

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.0)
project(hm LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "g++")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(FetchContent)

FetchContent_Declare(
    Help_Library
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/Gag91/Help_Library
    GIT_TAG        main
    GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Help_Library)

target_include_directories(hm PRIVATE ${Help_Library_SOURCE_DIR})

add_executable(hm
    src/cli/build.cpp
    src/cli/clean.cpp
    src/cli/help.cpp
    src/cli/install.cpp
    src/cli/license.cpp
    src/cli/show.cpp
    src/cli/version.cpp

    src/executor/workers.cpp
    src/fs/depfile.cpp
    src/fs/pch.cpp
    src/generator/cmake.cpp
    src/generator/compile_commands.cpp
    src/generator/generator.cpp
    src/generator/ninja.cpp
    src/getters/configs.cpp
    src/getters/maps.cpp
    src/getters/strings.cpp
    src/getters/vectors.cpp
    src/init/init.cpp
    src/main.cpp
    src/parser/appends.cpp
    src/parser/args.cpp
    src/parser/create.cpp
    src/parser/dependecy.cpp
    src/parser/parser.cpp
    src/parser/typos.cpp
    src/parser/var.cpp
    src/process/process.cpp
    src/toolchain/gcc_toolchain.cpp
    src/toolchain/go_toolchain.cpp
    src/toolchain/msvc_toolchain.cpp
    src/toolchain/toolchain.cpp
    src/toolchain/zig_toolchain.cpp
    src/toolchain/zigc_toolchain.cpp
    src/toolchain/zigcpp_toolchain.cpp
)

target_include_directories(hm PRIVATE
    include
)

target_compile_options(hm PRIVATE
    -std=c++20
    -Ibuild/HelpMake/dep/Help_Library
    -Iinclude
    -Wall
)
